program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-17861ba1.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]

    # The 1 markers define a diagonal segment when two lie on the same diagonal.
    pairs = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            if abs(r2 - r1) == abs(c2 - c1):
                pairs.append((abs(r2-r1), r1, c1, r2, c2))
    if pairs:
        _, r1, c1, r2, c2 = max(pairs)
        dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
        dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
        r, c = r1, c1
        while True:
            if out[r][c] not in (1, 6):
                out[r][c] = 1
            if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                break
            r += dr
            c += dc

        # 6 markers draw diagonals perpendicular to the segment. A lone 6
        # only does so when it lies on that segment.
        line_rise = (r2-r1) * (c2-c1) > 0
        extend_sixes = len(sixes) >= 2 or any(
            (r-r1) == (c-c1) * (1 if line_rise else -1)
            and min(r1, r2) <= r <= max(r1, r2)
            for r, c in sixes
        )
        if extend_sixes:
            for sr, sc in sixes:
                rr, cc = sr, sc
                # Orient opposite to the 1 segment and fill the full diagonal.
                step_r = 1
                step_c = -1 if line_rise else 1
                while 0 <= rr-step_r < h and 0 <= cc-step_c < w:
                    rr -= step_r
                    cc -= step_c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    if out[rr][cc] not in (1, 6):
                        out[rr][cc] = 6
                    rr += step_r
                    cc += step_c
    return out
'''
